create_openai_chat_completion: create an OpenAIServingChat instance to handle /v1/chat/completions requests with a tokenizer manager and template manager
handle_streaming_chat_request: handle a streaming chat completion request and yield SSE chunks with tool calls, reasoning content, and logprobs
handle_non_streaming_chat_request: handle a non-streaming chat completion request and return a full ChatCompletionResponse
build_chat_response_from_results: build a ChatCompletionResponse from model generation results including choices, usage, and optional sglext metadata
process_tool_calls_from_response: process tool calls from model text output using a FunctionCallParser or JsonArrayParser and return ToolCallProcessingResult
